items.html: Also the Tifferet of ZA — Bina did not expand in it, for the NHY of Ima are long and expand greatly in the two lines, right and left; but her Yesod, which is in the middle line, ends in his Daat. And then Bina would expand only in the five [Sefirot]; but after the building of the First Temple, Bina expanded until the second Hod of ZA, and they are now the seven Sefirot in which Bina expands within ZA.
